question: Which planet in our solar system is closest to the Sun?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Mercury__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Mercury is the smallest planet in our solar system.
 
• Mercury is slightly larger than Earth's Moon.
 
• Mercury has no moons and there are no rings around Mercury. 
 
• It is the closest planet to the Sun at a distance of about 36 million miles
 
• From the surface of Mercury, the Sun would appear more than three times as large as it does when viewed from Earth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7243bfe5bb325520505188e575f0b801e8f6c29efc8aeb7fd65e10c4b336088.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Some facts about the planets:

 
 
• Biggest Planet - Jupiter
 
• Biggest Satellite - Ganymede
 
• Green Planet - Uranus
 
• Closest Star of Solar System - Proxima Centauri
 
• Coldest Planet - Neptune
 
• Farthest Planet From Sun - Neptune
 
• A planet with the maximum number of satellites - Jupiter
 
• The fastest revolution in the solar system is by Mercury
 
• Hottest Planet - Venus
 
• Fastest Rotation in Solar System by Jupiter
 
• Nearest Planet to Earth - Venus
 
• The nearest planet to Sun is Mercury
 
• Red Planet - Mars
 
• The slowest Revolution in Solar System is by Neptune
 
• The slowest Rotation in Solar System is by Venus
 
• Smallest Planet - Mercury
 
• Atmosphere like Earth is on Titan
